what_this_is: The stands a person can take on something made for them, read by do-work/where-a-person-stands.mjs. `kind` is the type of the record a stand is kept as, one record per thing, so every change of stand is a new version of that one record. `stances` are the stands, one row each: `label` on its button, `said` what a reader shows once it is taken. A new stand is one row here.

words.refused_stance: stance is one of: {stances}, or null to take a stand back.
words.refused_answered_by: Ask your person where they stand, and set answered_by to "person": a stand is only ever theirs.
words.refused_ref: artifact_ref is the identity of the thing the stand is on: 1f: and 64 hex digits (BLAKE3), or file: and that identity. A file name is not an identity; read the file's identity first.
words.refused_why: why is the person's own words, as text.
